comment: Representative benchmark fixtures, one per model family, so optimization claims are measured against a declared shape set rather than a single synthetic GEMM. This document declares WHAT must be measured and which parity evidence applies; it never carries argv, environment, executable identity, or a measured result. Results live in receipts produced by a qualification run. scripts/validate_benchmark_matrix.py enforces every rule described here.

effect_class_evidence.comment: From the qualification contract in PERFORMANCE_ROADMAP.md. Evidence is selected by operation effect class rather than assuming every operation has gradients or an optimizer. The validator requires exactly these keys per class: a training fixture cannot omit gradient parity, and a serving fixture cannot invent one.

required_measurements.comment: Every fixture declares all five axes. A missing axis is a validator error, not a default, so a benchmark cannot quietly report throughput while hiding a compile-time or input-stall regression.

fixtures.notes: Routed terminal expert training across the three resident image buckets. The curriculum transition covers the resolution change, which is where static-shape compilation and allocator behaviour usually break.
Baseline non-distributed scratch RWKV. Portable because the RWKV-7 kernel has a pure-Python reference fallback, so a CPU baseline is meaningful even though it is not the production path.

Portable AO3 input-path fixture. Every step reads complete indexed raw documents of at least 128 KiB, decodes UTF-8, tokenizes all decoded text with the RWKV World tokenizer, and then buckets IDs; increasing batch size increases the distinct document set and bytes tokenized.
Continuation from an immutable parent checkpoint. Separate from scratch pretraining because warm-start changes both the optimizer-state cost and the quality baseline.
Transformer/MLA attention path. Named transformer rather than MLA so a future non-MLA attention variant is not mislabelled to fit the matrix.
Raw-pixel vision student against a frozen teacher. The quality gate is an image eval suite rather than perplexity, which is why family-specific gates are declared per fixture.
Short seeded fine-tuning arm. Its legacy counterpart has a wall-clock budget, so any speed claim here must fix a step budget first or the comparison measures the clock, not the kernel.
Teacher-student distillation. Teacher forward cost dominates, so the input-wait axis is load-bearing rather than incidental here.
Architecture conversion is a deterministic producer, not a training kernel: it has no optimizer and no resumed trajectory, so it is graded on content, ordering, and manifest parity.
Preference post-training arm. The quality gate is a reward rather than a loss, and paired seeds are required before any promotion decision.
Recurrent serving decode. Present so serving candidates are graded without an invented backward requirement, which is the failure the effect-class split exists to prevent.
